required_assertions: all 100 active object_id values are unique

plain_english: The exact frozen package constructs 98 library cards and two independent command-zone commanders.
Each of the 100 physical cards has a unique card_instance_id even when several cards share the same Oracle identity.
Each active rules object has a unique object_id, and every active deck object contains exactly one physical card instance.
title: Exact deck construction preserves duplicate basics and independent commanders
